question.text: The carbon-carbon bond distance in benzene is

options.text: Longer than a <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> single bond
Longer than a <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> double bond
Shorter than a <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> double bond
Shorter than a <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mo>≡</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> triple bond

solution.text:
The bond order of carbon-carbon bond is 1.5 in benzene.
Hence, carbon-carbon bond distance (1.397  A o ) is less than C = C single bond (1.33  A o ). and more than C=C double bond (1.33  A o )
